newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar gains ground, tracks NY rally.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar gains ground, tracks NY rally.

text.p: White sugar futures pushed higher on Thursday afternoon, mainly as a reflection of the technical strength in July raws, traders said.
"It's tracing New York a bit and the volume is not as good as it was yesterday," said one trader, adding that the bulk of the volume came from a hefty 560-lots AA.

In New York, benchmark July raws burst upwards to hit a high of 11.44 cents/lb, 18 points up on the day. Local traders said speculators were in no hurry to liquidate July longs with expiry still 12 sessions away.
But the liquidation should increase next week as the net spec long position is relatively heavy, they said.
New York's strength also sparked light buying of the August/July arbitrage as although the whites were firm, the strength was not keeping pace with that in the raws.
At 1555 GMT August was up $2.20 at $322.50, off the intraday high of $323.50. October was up $2.00 at $316.70 and volume totalled a modest 1,135 lots.
Traders said August appeared to be finding some support around $320 but they were still wary of further fund liquidation.
Nearby Paris futures also gained ground in a light turnover of 166 lots. August was up $2.50 at $322.50 and October up $2.00 at $317.00.
